::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/usage_alerts/{alert}"}
#docs
A customer alert includes `states` (see the states endpoint).

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `alert` | `string` | **yes** | The usage alert's id (ualt_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_alert`. One of `usage_alert`. |
| `id` | `string` | ualt_… |
| `kind` | `string` | The usage alert's kind. One of `usage_quantity`, `spend`, `credit_balance`, `credit_runway`. |
| `scope` | `string` | The usage alert's scope. One of `customer`, `plan`. |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_…, for customer scope. |
| `product` | `string` | The product, for plan scope. |
| `meter` | `string` | Meter key: usage (required) and spend (optional). |
| `interval` | `string` | day, week (ISO, from Monday) and month are calendar intervals in the business's time zone. period is the term of the subscription that bills the usage. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `period`. |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. All kinds but usage. |
| `unit` | `string` | Credit unit key, for balance and runway. Null: money. |
| `thresholds` | `array of object` | The usage alert's thresholds. |
| `email` | `boolean` | Email the customer when a threshold triggers. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True if the usage alert is active. |
| `created_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `states` | `array of object` | Customer alerts only. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The usage alert. |
| `404` | No such usage alert. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/usage_alerts/ualt_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
